title: Shared test-making practice, from first principles and evidence
why: Owner, Nov 1 20:49 CST: "yeah again i'm not too sure on how much best practices we absorb from good tests to better replicate good tests as i think we have few guidelines now asides for outcomes based thinking, but would like to see some more shared best practices on test making from first principles".
note: One shared home for test-making practice, derived from first principles and from evidence across the six repos: tests that went red on a real defect, mutation kills, red-first records, flake records, and the time-pinned tests being removed (step time-pinned-tests-go). Loaded by test-author and builder in every repo. Extend the existing homes (decision test-strategy-reset, agents/test-author.md), never a second. Each practice cites the test or incident that earned it. Lane started by the coordinator Nov 1 20:51 CST. Port: yes, every repo. Practice to add (owner 20:57 CST, step refusal-matches-rule): a check enforces its rule's outcome, not a stricter reading; a check and its rule are tested against each other.
